fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay in the US.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia prevista en EE. UU.
entry.quote: To enter the US, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

entry.en: To enter or transit through the US you must have either an ESTA or a visa.
entry.es: Para entrar o hacer tránsito por EE. UU. debes tener una ESTA o un visado.
entry.quote: To enter or transit through the US, you must have either an Electronic System for Travel Authorisation (ESTA) or a visa.

entry.en: Entry under the Visa Waiver Program requires an online form and a $40 payment, preferably at least 72 hours before arrival.
entry.es: La entrada bajo el Programa de Exención de Visado requiere un formulario en línea y un pago de 40 $, preferiblemente al menos 72 horas antes de la llegada.
entry.quote: Entry under the VWP requires the completion of an online form and a payment of $40, preferably at least 72 hours before arrival

entry.en: The 90-day limit of the Visa Waiver Program is not extendable under any circumstances.
entry.es: El límite de 90 días del Programa de Exención de Visado no se puede ampliar bajo ninguna circunstancia.
entry.quote: The 90-day limit is not extendable under any circumstances.

entry.en: Officials may ask to inspect your electronic devices, emails, text messages and social media activity.
entry.es: Los funcionarios pueden pedir inspeccionar tus dispositivos electrónicos, correos, mensajes de texto y actividad en redes sociales.
entry.quote: Officials may ask to inspect your electronic devices, emails, text messages, and social media activity.

entry.en: Anyone aged 17 and under travelling alone, with one parent or with a non-parent must have a letter of consent, preferably in English and notarised.
entry.es: Los menores de 18 años que viajen solos, con un solo progenitor o con alguien que no sea su padre o tutor deben llevar una carta de consentimiento, preferiblemente en inglés y notarizada.
entry.quote: have a letter of consent, preferably in English and notarised from one or both parents if travelling alone, with only one parent, or with someone who is not a parent or legal guardian

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in the US.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten llevar a cabo atentados en EE. UU.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try and carry out attacks in the US.

safety.en: Violent crime and gun crime rarely affect tourists, but you should take care in unfamiliar areas.
safety.es: Los delitos violentos y con armas rara vez afectan a los turistas, pero conviene tener cuidado en zonas desconocidas.
safety.quote: Violent crime and gun crime rarely affect tourists, but take care in unfamiliar areas.

safety.en: The Atlantic hurricane season normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes del Atlántico normalmente va de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The Atlantic hurricane season normally runs from June to November.

safety.en: Alaska, California, Hawaii, Oregon, Puerto Rico, Washington and the Mississippi River Valley are at higher risk for earthquakes.
safety.es: Alaska, California, Hawái, Oregón, Puerto Rico, Washington y todo el valle del Misisipi tienen mayor riesgo de terremotos.
safety.quote: Alaska, California, Hawaii, Oregon, Puerto Rico, Washington and the entire Mississippi River Valley are at higher risk for earthquakes.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Attitudes towards LGBT+ people differ hugely across the US, so check state and local laws.
safety.es: Las actitudes hacia las personas LGBT+ varían enormemente en el país, así que conviene consultar las leyes estatales y locales.
safety.quote: attitudes towards LGBT+ people differ hugely across the country

health.en: Medical treatment is expensive and there are no special arrangements for British visitors.
health.es: El tratamiento médico es caro y no hay acuerdos especiales para visitantes británicos.
health.quote: Medical treatment is expensive and there are no special arrangements for British visitors.

health.en: Some hospitals ask non-US residents to pay a deposit when admitted.
health.es: Algunos hospitales piden un depósito a los no residentes en EE. UU. al ingresar.
health.quote: Some hospitals ask non-US residents to pay a deposit when admitted.

health.en: UK prescriptions are not valid in the US.
health.es: Las recetas del Reino Unido no son válidas en EE. UU.
health.quote: UK prescriptions are not valid in the US.

health.en: Wikivoyage says to make sure your travel insurance is valid for the US, as some world-wide insurance does not cover it.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica asegurarse de que el seguro de viaje sea válido en EE. UU., ya que algún seguro mundial no lo cubre.
health.quote: Make sure that your travel insurance is valid for the U.S.: some "world-wide" insurance specifically does not cover the U.S.

health.en: Tap water is generally potable, though quality varies throughout the country.
health.es: El agua del grifo es generalmente potable, aunque su calidad varía según la zona.
health.quote: Tap water is generally potable, though quality varies throughout the country
Dial 911 and ask for an ambulance.

help.en: The emergency number in the US is 911 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en EE. UU. es el 911 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: You can call the FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres si necesitas ayuda urgente porque a un amigo o familiar le ha ocurrido algo en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

help.en: Ambulance services are not free in the US and you will be sent a bill after use.
help.es: Las ambulancias no son gratuitas en EE. UU. y se envía una factura después de usarlas.
help.quote: Ambulance services are not free in the U.S., and you will be sent a bill after use.

help.en: Any US phone connected to the network must be able to dial 911, and such calls are always free.
help.es: Cualquier teléfono de EE. UU. conectado a la red debe poder marcar el 911 y esas llamadas son siempre gratuitas.
help.quote: Any U.S. phone, regardless if it is "active" or not, must be able to dial 911 if it is connected to the network, and such calls are always free.

getting_in.en: Most visitors from outside Canada and Mexico arrive in the US by plane.
getting_in.es: La mayoría de los visitantes de fuera de Canadá y México llegan a EE. UU. en avión.
getting_in.quote: Most visitors from outside Canada and Mexico arrive in the United States by plane.

getting_in.en: The main international airports of entry include Atlanta, New York (EWR, JFK), Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Miami and Houston.
getting_in.es: Los principales aeropuertos internacionales de entrada incluyen Atlanta, Nueva York (EWR, JFK), Los Ángeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Seattle, Miami y Houston.
getting_in.quote: Atlanta (ATL IATA), New York City (EWR IATA & JFK IATA; for all airports, NYC IATA), Los Angeles (LAX IATA), Chicago (ORD IATA; for all airports, CHI IATA), San Francisco (SFO IATA), Seattle (SEA IATA), Miami (MIA IATA) and Houston (IAH IATA)

getting_in.en: Foreigners entering by land are required to pay a $30 fee when crossing the border.
getting_in.es: Los extranjeros que entran por tierra deben pagar una tasa de 30 $ al cruzar la frontera.
getting_in.quote: Foreigners entering by land are required to pay a $30 fee when crossing the border

getting_in.en: Delays at the busiest land crossings can approach 1-2 hours at peak times such as weekends and holidays.
getting_in.es: Las demoras en los cruces terrestres más concurridos pueden acercarse a 1-2 horas en horas punta como fines de semana y festivos.
getting_in.quote: delays at the busiest crossings can approach 1–2 hours at peak times such as weekends and holidays.

getting_around.en: Coast-to-coast flights take about 6 hours from east to west and 5 hours from west to east.
getting_around.es: Un vuelo de costa a costa dura unas 6 horas de este a oeste y 5 de oeste a este.
getting_around.quote: Coast-to-coast travel takes about 6 hours from east to west, and 5 hours from west to east

getting_around.en: Domestic flights in the US often cost twice as much as flights of similar distance in Europe and Asia.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos nacionales en EE. UU. suelen costar el doble que los de distancia similar en Europa y Asia.
getting_around.quote: domestic flights in the U.S. often cost twice as much as flights to similar distances in Europe and Asia.

getting_around.en: The US does not have a well-developed passenger rail network.
getting_around.es: EE. UU. no tiene una red ferroviaria de pasajeros bien desarrollada.
getting_around.quote: The United States does not have a well-developed passenger rail network.

getting_around.en: Amtrak offers a 30-day USA Rail Pass which covers the entire country.
getting_around.es: Amtrak ofrece un USA Rail Pass de 30 días que cubre todo el país.
getting_around.quote: Amtrak offers a 30-day USA Rail Pass which covers the entire country.

getting_around.en: Americans drive on the right in left-hand drive vehicles.
getting_around.es: En EE. UU. se conduce por la derecha en vehículos con el volante a la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Americans drive on the right in left-hand drive vehicles.

getting_around.en: If you are caught driving under the influence of alcohol, you will almost certainly be arrested.
getting_around.es: Si te sorprenden conduciendo bajo los efectos del alcohol, casi con certeza serás arrestado.
getting_around.quote: If you are caught driving under the influence of alcohol, you will almost certainly be arrested.

money.en: The US currency is the United States dollar, divided into 100 cents.
money.es: La moneda de EE. UU. es el dólar estadounidense, dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The  U.S. currency is the United States dollar ($), divided into 100 cents

money.en: Foreign credit or debit cards should be accepted in most places.
money.es: Las tarjetas de crédito o débito extranjeras deberían aceptarse en la mayoría de los lugares.
money.quote: Foreign credit or debit cards should be accepted in most places

money.en: ATMs generally charge about $2 to $4 to cards issued by other banks.
money.es: Los cajeros suelen cobrar unos 2 a 4 $ a las tarjetas emitidas por otros bancos.
money.quote: generally charge about $2 to $4 to cards issued by other banks

money.en: Tipping is widely practiced in the United States.
money.es: La propina está muy extendida en Estados Unidos.
money.quote: Tipping is widely practiced in the United States.

money.en: There is no federal sales tax (such as VAT or GST) in the US.
money.es: No existe un impuesto federal sobre las ventas (como el IVA) en EE. UU.
money.quote: There is no federal sales tax (such as VAT or GST) in the US.

money.en: It is often better to acquire US dollars in your home country before travel.
money.es: A menudo es mejor conseguir dólares estadounidenses en tu país antes de viajar.
money.quote: it is often better to acquire U.S. dollars in your home country before travel

etiquette.en: It is polite to firmly shake hands when meeting someone or being introduced.
etiquette.es: Es de buena educación dar un apretón de manos firme al conocer o ser presentado a alguien.
etiquette.quote: It is polite to firmly shake hands when meeting someone or being introduced

etiquette.en: Punctuality is valued, and being five minutes late for a meeting is not usually a problem.
etiquette.es: Se valora la puntualidad, y llegar cinco minutos tarde a una reunión no suele ser un problema.
etiquette.quote: Punctuality is valued: being five minutes late for a meeting is not usually a problem

etiquette.es: El discurso político está sumamente polarizado.

etiquette.en: Gun control is a very polarizing and sensitive issue.
etiquette.es: El control de armas es un tema muy polarizante y delicado.
etiquette.quote: Gun control is a very polarizing and sensitive issue.

etiquette.en: Dress in the US tends to be fairly casual.
etiquette.es: La vestimenta en EE. UU. tiende a ser bastante informal.
etiquette.quote: Dress in the U.S. tends to be fairly casual.

etiquette.en: Nude bathing is not generally acceptable and is usually even illegal except at certain designated spaces.
etiquette.es: El baño sin ropa no suele ser aceptable y normalmente es incluso ilegal salvo en ciertos espacios designados.
etiquette.quote: Nude bathing is not generally acceptable and is usually even illegal except at certain designated spaces.

connectivity.en: Buying a SIM card or eSIM can be cheaper than international roaming for using your personal phone.
connectivity.es: Comprar una SIM o eSIM puede ser más barato que el roaming internacional para usar tu teléfono personal.
connectivity.quote: Buying a SIM card or eSIM is a better way to use your personal phone and can be cheaper than international roaming.

connectivity.en: The three largest mobile networks in the US are AT&T, Verizon Wireless and T-Mobile.
connectivity.es: Las tres mayores redes móviles de EE. UU. son AT&T, Verizon Wireless y T-Mobile.
connectivity.quote: The three largest mobile phone networks in the U.S. are AT&T, Verizon Wireless, and T-Mobile.

connectivity.en: Public pay phones are very rare even in major cities.
connectivity.es: Los teléfonos públicos son muy raros incluso en las grandes ciudades.
connectivity.quote: Public pay phones are very rare even in major cities

connectivity.en: The country code for the US is +1.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de EE. UU. es +1.
connectivity.quote: The country code for the U.S. is +1.
